about: Jenet G. Pequeno is the founder and principal attorney of The Law Offices of Jenet G. Pequeno, LLC, based in Arlington Heights, Illinois. Advocating for clients throughout the Chicago metropolitan area in both English and Spanish, he focuses his practice on all aspects of family law, including:
· Initial custody determinations and post-decree modification

Mr. Pequeno’s upbringing under challenging circumstances has enabled him to reinforce his practice of helping families navigate through difficult times. As a seasoned professional, he uses his skills and experience to craft a strategy that addresses the specific problems his clients face during times of crisis. His dedication to his clients and their goals makes him a reliable ally who fights for their rights and interests.

A graduate of Northern Illinois University, Mr. Pequeno earned his bachelor’s degree in political science in 2001. He later went on to receive his Juris Doctor from the University of Miami School of Law in 2004. He is licensed to practice before all Illinois state courts and is a significantly involved member of the Northwest Suburban Bar Association and the Illinois State Bar Association.

Mr. Pequeno has received many honors and recognitions, including his selection to the list of Top 10 Best Attorneys in Exceptional and Outstanding Client Service by the American Institute of Family Law Attorneys. Apart from his “Excellent” rating on Avvo, he has been named to the Top 40 Under 40 family law lawyers by the American Society of Legal Advocates and as a Distinguished Lawyer by Expert Network.
